implementation_summary: scripts/scan-build-secrets.mjs scans folders (binary files included, links not followed) for Anthropic, OpenRouter, OpenAI and Google AI key patterns, printing only file and pattern name; exit 1 on a key, exit 2 on usage error or an empty, missing or unreadable folder. scripts/scan-commit-secrets.mjs (CHK-SECRETS) lists the commit set with git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard, leaves out the .gitleaks.toml allowlist paths, copies regular files into a temp folder, runs aieos scan secrets --json --root <tmp>, drops whole {{...}} placeholder findings, adds a committed-env-file finding, prints rule, file and line only, and fails closed. CI gains a build-secret-scan job that scans packages/wizard/dist and the runner image's /app plus image config and history; the gitleaks history scan is unchanged.

tests_executed.output_excerpt: Scanned 435 file(s) (266 allowlisted, 1 placeholder ignored): 0 finding(s). exit 0

tests_proposed: PR CI run: confirm the build-secret-scan job steps 'Scan the wizard bundle' and 'Scan the runner image' pass (validation_waiver)
Local docker build plus export and scan to measure job time and check node_modules for false positives
risks: .dockerignore (not owned): .env, .qa-keys.json and *.local only match at the root, so a nested packages/<pkg>/.env would be copied into a locally built image. Recommend **/.env* and **/.qa-keys.json.
Image scan covers /app plus image config and history, not the Playwright base layers; third-party node_modules in /app could produce a false positive.
Runner image ships packages/*/tests and the image scan has no allowlist; tests must assemble fake keys at run time.
Placeholder filtering depends on the AI-EOS preview format; a change makes the gate fail closed.
The AI-EOS scanner skips folders named dist/build/bin/out/vendor/target.
CI builds the runner Docker image on every PR and push to main.
The bundle and image CI steps were not run locally; covered by the validation waiver.
handoff: CHK-BE-011-UNIT and CHK-SECRETS are ready to run. The developer confirms on the PR CI run that the build-secret-scan job passes. Recommend a follow-up to harden .dockerignore with **/.env* and **/.qa-keys.json.
